method.nativeRule: Latest receiver-private hypothesis.* association for the delivered token from the strictly preceding prefix (association turn < action turn), weights over the recorded candidate order plus 1e-12 epsilon, normalized. Delivered token without a preceding association scores uniform (source uniform-missing-token). Mirrors indexLv01TrainingLedger/predictLv01NativeLedger semantics in packages/learners/src/ledger-value-prediction.ts.
method.prefixRule: Per receiver action at turn t: all hypothesis.created/revised/contradicted events on the receiver's own ledger with event turn < t. Same-turn associations are excluded (they are post-outcome records). Ledger cutoff per case: (sequence of last preceding event, turn t-1).
method.outcomeScoring: Multiclass Brier loss sum((q-one_hot(action))^2) on the observed receiver action position. Action/target positions recovered as index of turn-record selectedTypeCode/targetTypeCode in the recorded candidate order.
method.ordinaryFitRule: Expanding window: each case is scored by count models (Laplace +1, exact packages/analysis/src/ledger-value.ts count-model semantics) fit on strictly preceding same-receiver cases only. No later data enters any fit.
method.omittedPredictor: ordinary-record-softmax omitted: 565-coefficient refit per case is degenerate on <=87 preceding rows and the committed TypeScript implementation was not executed in this docs-only draft. Recorded as a method limitation, not a silent default.
method.liveInferenceReference: interpretation.recorded inferredDistribution scored against the taken action as a descriptive reference only. It is the live policy's own output, not frozen exact replay, and supports no fidelity claim.
method.implementationNote: Computed read-only from sealed bundles by a throwaway probe reimplementing the registered v1 predictor semantics; sealed evidence untouched. No parallel analytics framework created. A committed implementation under R04/R05 must call the analysis/learners packages directly.
method.caseRowRounding: Per-case Brier values are stored rounded to 6 decimals; overall/running/evaluating means were computed at full precision. Recomputing means from stored rows differs by at most 1.1e-7 (evaluating native, v18); coverage and counts recompute exactly.
method.associationAgeConvention: associationAgeTurnsOrNull is actionTurn minus associationTurn (strictly positive for covered cases). This is one more than indexLv01TrainingLedger's cutoff-relative age with cutoff.turn = actionTurn - 1.
method.driftPairRule: recordedAssociationDriftPairs counts consecutive same-token associations within each receiver's own ledger (never pooled across ledgers). Every first-per-(token,ledger) association is hypothesis.created (verified 0 exceptions across 7 dyads), so pair counts equal revised + contradicted counts; argmax flips use first-max index over the 16 raw weights.

limitations: Retrospective development diagnosis only: descriptive prefix/coverage/staleness/scoring. Supplies no pilot variance, confirmatory finding, prior prediction commitment, or next-study effect size; no inferential reuse.
Seven dyads have distinct execution commits and seeds; each is reported separately and never pooled into a research N. Incompatible topologies/configurations are not combined.
Associations are post-outcome ledger records; the strictly-preceding prefix rule is what keeps every native prediction prospective. Same-turn leakage is excluded by construction.

Unrecorded policy probability drift is unavailable: no frozen-replay execution was performed in this docs-only draft. Only recorded association drift (L2 between consecutive same-token associations) is reported. Policy snapshots are retained and digested for future replay.
No exact-replay fidelity comparison: the live-inference reference is the live policy's own output, not an independent frozen replay.
Stored live distributions are rounded to 6 decimals (sums deviate from 1 by at most 1e-6); Brier values use stored rounded values.
R01 attempt/lifetime/capacity reconciliation was in progress by a sibling session at draft time; this manifest makes no lifetime-iteration or resource-balance claim. Detector v3 was not inspected.

claimBoundary: This manifest and its companion diagnosis support only bounded retrospective observations about retained development ledger coverage, staleness, and action-prediction scoring.
